name: PARRY!!
desc:
PARRY, the game where you SWING and DASH and PARRY and DASH and SWING AND PARRY
(version 3.1.0!)

CURRENTLY FEATURINGGG 2 gamemodes, 2.5 weapons, 3 stages (campaign), 2.5 mini stages, 11 unique enemies, and 4 bosses!! if that doesnt sound cool, idk what does.
AND all the above numbers will go UP with updates.

BASE CONTROLS (in case you forget)
M1 (R2 or X): melee
F (R1 or Y): parry
E (L2): counter
Q (B): dash
T (DPadUp): TAUNT
CTRL (DPadDown): unlock camera
R (L1): overcharge (but only if you have that upgrade)
Z (DPadLeft): ability (only if you have that too)

SUPPORTS computer, mobile, and console (at least the xbox controller, tell me if other controllers dont work)

\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/

PLAY ABOVE 60 FPS AT YOUR OWN RISK! i forgot that was a thing until i made most the game, so some stuff goes really fast. my bad.

btw im not selling this game, and i probably never will. if someone is trying to sell it as me, its a scam.
